title: the drafts folder holds its own .gitignore (a single * line), created when missing and never rewritten
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the drafts rows of the other decisions (a just-in-time build is a draft kept in .jitso/drafts/ and validated by code)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). The first draft creates `.jitso/drafts/.gitignore` with the content `*` and a newline, so a draft is never committed by accident. An existing `.gitignore` of that folder is left as it is. The oracle has no `build draft` and no `build discard` (the runner maps only `build list`): both answer `unknown command` on stderr with exit 2, so every expectation that needs their output FAILS on it.
